Door County Map

 Interactive Door County Map

Use this interactive map of Door County to find locations to launch a water craft, cool things to see, and extra special spots along the coast. We are here to appreciate and respect the Door County Coastline. Silent sports is our focus, but we understand the coastline is here to be shared with everyone.  Enjoy and see you on the water!

Our two locations (Bluffs and Caves) are marked with a Green Marker.

Our kayak tour locations that we can do with a private tour are marked with a Blue Marker like Whitefish Bay Dunes State Park.

Cool things to see and experience are marked with a Yellow Marker.

All other Door County Map Kayaking locations are possible, even if you don’t see it listed on our map. Explore and if there is a Door County tour you want to do, sign up for a private tour and request that location in the comments section.
